tags.chapter_name: Center of Mass Momentum and Collision

question.text: A mass ' $m$ ' moves with a velocity $v$ and collides inelastically with another identical mass. After collision the $1^{\text {st }}$ mass moves with velocity $v / \sqrt{3}$ in a direction perpendicular to the initial direction of motion. Find the speed of the $2^{\text {nd }}$ mass after collision

solution.text: $m v=m v_1 \cos \theta$ $0=\frac{m v}{\sqrt{3}}-m v_1 \sin \theta$ $\therefore v_1=\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}} v$
